mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_meeting( meet_id, author_id, title, content, status, location_text, meet_at, application_deadline, max_participants, meet_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEAL_MEETING.NEXTVAL, #{author_id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status},#{location_text}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{meet_at}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP( #{application_deadline, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI'), #{max_participants}, #{meet_status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT t.meet_id, t.author_id, t.title, t.meet_status, t.content, t.location_text, TO_CHAR(t.meet_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS meet_at, TO_CHAR(t.application_deadline,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS application_deadline, t.max_participants, TO_CHAR(t.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, m.name, t.view_count FROM meal_meeting t JOIN member m ON t.author_id = m.member_id WHERE t.status = 0 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.meet_id DESC

SELECT t.meet_id, t.author_id, t.title, t.meet_status, t.content, t.location_text, TO_CHAR(t.meet_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS meet_at, TO_CHAR(t.application_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS application_deadline, t.max_participants, TO_CHAR(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, m.name, t.view_count FROM meal_meeting t JOIN member m ON t.author_id = m.member_id WHERE t.meet_id = #{meet_id} AND t.status = 0 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE meal_meeting SET view_count = NVL(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE meet_id = #{meet_id} AND status = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM meet_participant WHERE meet_id = #{meet_id} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meet_participant ( meet_id, member_id, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{meet_id}, #{member_id}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.meet_id, p.member_id, m.name, p.status, TO_CHAR(p.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at FROM meet_participant p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.meet_id = #{meet_id} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
